### <i class="bi bi-stopwatch" aria-hidden="true"></i> Yak

**Your Activity Keeper:** a time tracker with Markdown notes and tasks that runs entirely in your browser.
I built it for myself and for fellow consultants who bill by the hour and keep notes on everything.

- No install, no account, and no server holding your data
- Optional peer-to-peer sync between your own devices; the relay only introduces them and never sees your data
- Notes and tasks are plain Markdown, with an Obsidian plugin that syncs both ways
- Toggl import, and CSV and JSON export
- Built to pass an IT review: no remote code, a strict security policy, and few dependencies

Yak is in alpha.
I built it largely with AI coding agents, as a hands-on test of the workflows I help teams adopt.
